info.title: Staff authentication, administration and project business API
info.description: Live v1 JSON contract. Send the API key through the trusted private gateway. Business routes require the current database permission, an explicit grant and an ACTIVE project. Business list cursors and IDs are decimal strings. Global staff IDs use JSON numbers. See the separate application-registry.openapi.json for project/grant management, and mobile-delivery.openapi.json for delivery lifecycle operations.

Error401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked credentials.

Error403.description: The configured ingress requires an authenticated secure gateway. Staff routes also check permissions and applicable password confirmation.

Error404.description: Resource missing or inaccessible in the application scope.

Error409.description: The current resource state conflicts with this request.

Error413.description: Request body exceeds its byte limit.

Error429.description: Rate budget exhausted at a configured ingress.

Error500.description: An unexpected server failure is returned as internal server error.
